labels.description: The labels for the chart's axis. This is JavaScript array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type String; they are not in string representation.

data.description: The data points for the series. This is JavaScript array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type String; they are not in string representation.

color.description: The default color for the series. Optional parameter. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.

chartLayout.description: The layout object of the chart where the series will be added. This is JavaScript dict type parameter in string representation.
